result.topic_en: Calculations on a second-order ODE of Lamé type, $\Theta(\lambda)u'' + \tfrac12\Theta'(\lambda)u' + g^2(\lambda-\eta)(\lambda-\varepsilon)u=0$, with a change of variable to elliptic integrals, an exponential substitution, an asymptotic series in powers of $g$ via a Riccati equation, and a power series solution of $u''+xu=0$ (Airy-type).

methods.what: Power series solution of the Airy-type equation u''+xu=0 via a three-term recurrence
Closed form of the series coefficients using Gauss's Pi function
Change of variable to the elliptic integral e, removing the first-derivative term
Evaluation of a Beta integral via Pi functions
Exponential (WKB-type) substitution factoring out the leading behaviour
Riccati equation for the logarithmic derivative v
Asymptotic expansion of v in inverse powers of g
Recursion for the coefficients of the asymptotic series
First coefficients of the asymptotic series
